title: Canonical comparison of rho-section and coordinate-Hopf scalar structures
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $S$ an affine $F$-group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme]. Let $C_H=F[S]$ with the canonical coordinate-Hopf scalar structure of [def-sfb-rational-highest-weight-data], and let $C_\Gamma$ be the relative-global-sections algebra of [def-sfb-rho-section-module-data]. Both have the same underlying ring $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$. Their scalar maps agree: for every $a\in F$, the images of $a$ in this ring are equal. Define the canonical $F$-algebra equivalence $C_H\simeq C_\Gamma$ to have identity underlying ring equivalence, with scalar compatibility given by this equality.
